.sp
The third field \fIkey file\fR describes the file to use for decrypting the encrypted data of the \fIsource device\fR.
.sp

commands.command:
set -e
umask 077
if [ ! -e /root/.secure-volume.key ]; then dd if=/dev/urandom of=/root/.secure-volume.key bs=32 count=1 2>/dev/null; fi
chmod 600 /root/.secure-volume.key
if [ ! -e /srv/secure.luks ]; then dd if=/dev/zero of=/srv/secure.luks bs=1M count=512 2>/dev/null; fi
chmod 600 /srv/secure.luks
ls -l /root/.secure-volume.key /srv/secure.luks
wc -c /root/.secure-volume.key /srv/secure.luks

commands.command:
set -e
loopdev=$(losetup -f)
losetup "$loopdev" /srv/secure.luks
if cryptsetup isLuks "$loopdev" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'already LUKS'; else cryptsetup -q luksFormat "$loopdev" /root/.secure-volume.key; fi
cryptsetup isLuks "$loopdev"
cryptsetup luksUUID "$loopdev"
printf 'LOOP=%s\n' "$loopdev"

commands.command:
set -e
loopdev=$(losetup -j /srv/secure.luks | sed 's/:.*//' | head -1)
[ -n "$loopdev" ]
if [ ! -e /dev/mapper/secure ]; then cryptsetup -d /root/.secure-volume.key luksOpen "$loopdev" secure; fi
mkfs.ext3 -q -L SECURE /dev/mapper/secure
mkdir -p /srv/secure
mount /dev/mapper/secure /srv/secure
printf 'encrypted-volume-ready\n' >/srv/secure/healthcheck.txt
sync
cryptsetup status secure
mount | grep ' on /srv/secure '
df -hT /srv/secure
cat /srv/secure/healthcheck.txt

commands.command:
set -e
cp -p /etc/fstab /etc/fstab.pre-secure
[ ! -e /etc/crypttab ] || cp -p /etc/crypttab /etc/crypttab.pre-secure
printf '%s\n' 'secure /srv/secure.luks /root/.secure-volume.key luks' >/etc/crypttab
if ! grep -q '^[[:space:]]*/dev/mapper/secure[[:space:]]' /etc/fstab; then printf '%s\n' '/dev/mapper/secure /srv/secure ext3 defaults 0 2' >>/etc/fstab; fi
chmod 600 /etc/crypttab /root/.secure-volume.key /srv/secure.luks
printf '%s\n' '--- /etc/crypttab ---'
cat /etc/crypttab
printf '%s\n' '--- fstab secure entry ---'
grep '/srv/secure' /etc/fstab
printf '%s\n' '--- cryptdisks defaults ---'
cat /etc/default/cryptdisks 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- boot order ---'
ls -l /etc/rcS.d/*cryptdisks* /etc/rcS.d/*mountall* 2>/dev/null || true
